Prepares the v1.0.1 typography revision from the verified v1.0.0 DOCX. The revision applies B Nazanin to Persian body text, headings, lists, captions, tables, headers and footers while preserving the book content.

## Current status

The official B Nazanin Regular and Bold faces were verified. A 40-page internal PDF rendered with both faces embedded as subsets. Publication remains **NO-GO** pending written permission for public font embedding, a render with a stable production renderer, and full-size visual QA of all 40 pages.

## Links

- [Official Borna Rayaneh font package](https://www.bornaray.com/Content/downloads/bfonts.zip)
- [Font SHA-256 values and internal render evidence](https://github.com/y0bahrambeigi/bhb/blob/253fe38a2283dc07990f1b02ebdf3efaeeb3659d/publications/smart-structures/B_NAZANIN_FONT_INTAKE_2026-10-26.md#verification-on-2026-11-06)
- [Persian header and footer fix](https://github.com/y0bahrambeigi/bhb/commit/9b0d0adf6b3ab85530b83aa320a1aca216279b6c)
- [Verified v1.0.0 GitHub release](https://github.com/y0bahrambeigi/bhb/releases/tag/smart-structures-v1.0.0)
- [Matching Figshare v2 record](https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.34063335.v2)

# Smart Structures v1.0.1 — B Nazanin font intake (2026-10-26)

## Original intake on 2026-10-26

A user-supplied file named `BNazanin(1).ttf` was inspected locally. This document contains **metadata only** and intentionally does not distribute or commit the font binary.

- SHA-256: `85e99f938567b29918530044b0111799ff6a9ba4376ca1adba495a5af5a91c46`
- Internal family: `B Nazanin`; style: `Regular`; PostScript name: `BNazanin`
- Font format: TrueType; cmap parses; glyphs for sampled Persian text and digits present
- Installed in isolated validation environment; `fc-match 'B Nazanin'` resolves to the supplied font
- Requesting Bold currently resolves to Regular: **no independent Bold face verified**
- OS/2 fsType: 0 (no embedding restriction indicated by that machine-readable flag; this is **not** proof of copyright license/redistribution permission)

## Initial publication checklist

1. Verify lawful possession and publication/embedding terms for the supplied font. No font binary should be committed.
2. Obtain and validate actual B Nazanin Bold face where Heading 1/2, captions and table headers require it; synthetic bold requires explicit visual approval.
3. Obtain frozen v1.0.0 source DOCX from a verified release asset and verify source checksum.
4. Build v1.0.1 DOCX/PDF using real regular/bold faces, complete automated and **all 40-page visual QA** (equations, tables, RTL, page breaks, fallback).
5. Generate final hashes and metadata, review and merge, publish Figshare v3 and the matching GitHub tag/release.

## Status at initial intake

**G1 partially met / G2 NO-GO.** Font identity and local family resolution have been verified; license and Bold availability remain unverified. The released v1.0.0 and Figshare v2 must not be changed.

## Verification on 2026-11-06

- The public GitHub v1.0.0 and Figshare v2 DOCX and PDF matched byte for byte and passed the release-attached SHA-256 manifest. The DOCX used for testing hashed to `2111389b572b4d71175faaac42d6ace1f0394f60871ccb127ee0fdb0027301c2`. The `FINAL_QA_v1.0.0.json` in the historical tag records different values. The release attachments and matching Figshare files establish the input used here.
- The [official Borna Rayaneh package](https://www.bornaray.com/Content/downloads/bfonts.zip) supplies distinct B Nazanin Regular and Bold files. Both report Version 2.01, Build 1379 and OS/2 fsType 0. Regular (`BNazanin`, weight 400) SHA-256: `7ae508e94fbbf35f1a43f7a93d125f003debcf0e0af64805309f3a3ebac4188c`. Bold (`BNazaninBold`, weight 700) SHA-256: `2293311d5738f48bf7dbf3bb38e1b7fa1475e955893e0b026258493ac1d4658c`. The official Regular has a different hash from the file inspected in October.
- Fontconfig selected both official faces in isolation. An internal LibreOffice 26.8 alpha render of commit `9b0d0adf6b3ab85530b83aa320a1aca216279b6c` had 40 pages. Poppler reported embedded subsets of both faces. Automated extraction found only these two faces in PDF text spans containing characters in U+0600–U+06FF after the header and footer fix. The body image region matched the preview before that fix on all 40 pages. These checks cover the internal render and targeted regression only. Full-size visual review and production renderer validation are pending.
- The official package and the font metadata supplied no license text governing public PDF or DOCX embedding. Written confirmation remains the G1 blocker. The internal render and font files are excluded from release assets.

**Current decision: NO-GO for publication.**

## Release readiness audit — Smart Structures v1.0.1 (NO-GO)

Checked PR #82 at head `74b42a6ac2fab246932a8a36d287fe7609ab5274`. PR remains open/draft, with two changed files; no submitted PR reviews and no commit status contexts were returned. The surfaced successful workflow run is **Publish Smart Structures RC1**, not evidence of v1.0.1 typography QA.

### Outstanding gates (ordered)
- [ ] **G1 Licensed font:** Confirm a legally obtained B Nazanin installation, font family/version and renderer font resolution; do not commit proprietary font binaries.
- [ ] **G2 Final rendering:** Regenerate DOCX/PDF using the actual B Nazanin font. Record rendering environment and inspect all 40 pages, equations, captions, tables, page breaks, headers/footers and RTL text; ensure no fallback/substitution.
- [ ] **G3 Freeze assets:** Record final DOCX/PDF SHA-256 values and verify downloaded files. The candidate DOCX hash in TYPOGRAPHY_V1.0.1.md is **not** a release hash.
- [ ] **G4 Release metadata:** Update version/citation metadata against these final verified assets; avoid placeholder DOI or links.
- [ ] **G5 Review and merge:** Provide QA evidence, complete code review and relevant CI, remove draft status only after evidence, merge and record exact merge SHA.
- [ ] **G6 Figshare v3:** Create/publish the intended new version and verify DOI, file versions and checksums.
- [ ] **G7 Release:** Create `smart-structures-v1.0.1` tag at the verified release commit and publish matching GitHub assets/release notes.

### Additional code QA points
The current script handles top-level paragraphs/tables but requires coverage checks for nested tables and header/footer content. Skipping runs named Cambria Math alone does not establish full mathematical preservation. Validate these before approving G2.

**Stop rule:** No merge, Figshare v3 publication, tag or public v1.0.1 release until prerequisite gates pass with reproducible evidence. Preserve historical v1.0.0 and Figshare v2 without modification.

### Follow-up audit: existing release files must not be reused for v1.0.1

Additional checks of `publications/smart-structures/` on the PR branch found:

- `SHA256SUMS` currently lists three **v1.0.0-rc1** asset names, not v1.0.1 outputs. Generate a separate checksum manifest from final v1.0.1 DOCX/PDF; do not repurpose this historical manifest.
- `CITATION.cff` currently identifies version `1.0.0` and DOI `10.6084/m9.figshare.34063335`. Keep the historical reference intact; populate any new v1.0.1 archive metadata only from confirmed Figshare v3 information.
- `FONT_LICENSES.md` documents embedded Shabnam, Sahel and Vazirmatn fonts; it does **not** establish distribution/embedding rights for B Nazanin.
- In the available execution environment, font lookup for `B Nazanin` resolves to `Noto Sans`, so the v1.0.1 final rendering gate cannot be certified there.

**Decision: NO-GO continues.** This is evidence-gathering only; no historical release/tag, Figshare record, or public asset has been modified.

Implementation update: added `publications/smart-structures/tools/verify_bnazanin_v101.py` to the PR branch (head `d1670a04edec5f692ad2d78837df00fa75785995`). This is a fail-closed local preflight for licensed font resolution (`fc-match`), PDF font presence (`pdffonts`), 40-page count (`pdfinfo`), DOCX integrity, and SHA-256 evidence generation. Usage: `python publications/smart-structures/tools/verify_bnazanin_v101.py --docx PATH_TO_FINAL.docx --pdf PATH_TO_FINAL.pdf --report qa/v1.0.1-preflight.json`. This is **not** proof that G1/G2 passed: actual licensed B Nazanin and final assets are not available for independent validation; all-page manual QA is still mandatory. PR remains Draft, and v1.0.0/Figshare v2 remain untouched.
